description: Change of use from Office (Use class E(C)(ii)) to Mixed use as 1x Studio flat (Use class C3) and Tea room/Creative Space (Use class Sui Generis)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The proposal would result in
the unjustified loss of existing Class E Main Town Centre Use floorspace within
a designated Neighbourhood Parade through its conversion to residential use. No
evidence has been submitted to demonstrate that the commercial floor space is
no longer required, including the 24-month active marketing exercise required
by Appendix 6 of the Harrow Local Plan. As such, the proposal has failed to
demonstrate that the loss of Main Town Centre Use floorspace is justified and
is therefore contrary to Policy LE1(H) and Appendix 6 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and the objectives of Section 6 of the National Planning Policy Framework.&nbsp;</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
proposed residential unit, because of its significantly substandard floor space,
poor internal layout, limited outlook and failure to demonstrate an acceptable
standard of residential amenity, would provide an unacceptable living
environment for future occupiers. Furthermore, the applicant has failed to
demonstrate that the proposed dwelling would achieve the accessible and
adaptable standards required by Building Regulation M4(2). The proposal
therefore fails to provide a high quality, inclusive and safe residential
environment and is contrary to Paragraph 135 of the National Planning Policy
Framework, Policies D5, D6, D7, D12, D13 and D14 of the London Plan (2021), and
Policies GR1 and GR3B of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
application fails to demonstrate that adequate refuse and recycling storage
would be provided to serve the proposed mixed-use development. Insufficient
information has been submitted to demonstrate appropriate, secure and enclosed
refuse storage, or the separate storage and collection of residential and
commercial waste streams. The proposal therefore fails to accord with Policy
SI7 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy CE1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
proposal would result in the creation of a single self-contained studio
dwelling within an area with a Public Transport Accessibility Level (PTAL) of
2. The proposal does not form part of a larger residential development, would
not provide a balanced mix of dwelling sizes, and no evidence has been
submitted to demonstrate that a studio dwelling is the only form of residential
development capable of being delivered on the site. Accordingly, the proposal
fails to satisfy any of the circumstances in which proposals comprising solely
studio and one-bedroom dwellings will be supported under Policy HO4(C) of the
Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041). The proposal is therefore unacceptable in principle and
contrary to Policies HO1 and HO4(C) of the Harrow Local Plan and Policy H1 of
the London Plan (2021).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
application fails to demonstrate that adequate, secure and policy-compliant
cycle parking can be provided to serve the proposed residential unit. Given the
constrained nature of the site and the absence of any identified cycle parking
provision, it has not been demonstrated that the development would adequately
support sustainable modes of transport. The proposal is therefore contrary to
Section 9 of the National Planning Policy Framework, Policy T5 of the London
Plan (2021) and Policy M2 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
